name: Kairos
gloss: Power is what moves the world. Windows open and close, act while the window is open.

name: Shi (勢)
gloss: Power is what moves the world. Build up your own position rather than force outcomes and victories will come naturally

name: Grotian
gloss: Rules make cooperation long-lasting, but rules that are not properly enforced are not rules.

analogue.label: Hugo Grotius / De Jure Belli ac Pacis

name: Concert
gloss: Rules make cooperation long-lasting. The restraint and cooperation of the strong is what sustains them.

name: Satyagraha
gloss: The international system is held together by shared beliefs. To change the balance of power, one must change the narrative.

name: Musyawarah
gloss: The international system is held together by shared beliefs. True legitimacy is built slowly through consensus, never demanded.

name: Dirigisme
gloss: Production, finance, and dependence organize politics, and the state should play a leading role in shaping them.

name: Dependencia
gloss: Production, finance, and dependence organize politics. Reducing dependence and building national resilience is critical.
